author: val
body: SETTINGS file on the ESP root, fixed layout so a reader that is not this code can tell what it found. Bytes 0..3 magic 'C' 'S' 'T' '1'; 4..5 record count, u16 little-endian; 6..7 zero; then records of eight bytes: +0..3 key id, u32 little-endian; +4..7 value plus 2147483648, u32 little-endian. The bias exists because a number read back out of a buffer is unsigned, so an unbiased -1 returns as 4294967295 and the range check refuses a value that was legal when written. A header claiming more records than the length holds is refused whole.

author: val
body: Every key declares its default and range, and a value outside the range is REFUSED on the way out and on the way in, never clamped: a file holding a value this build no longer admits leaves the default standing.
